```{python}
#| label: shared-connected-evidence
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path
import contextlib
import html
import io
import json
import sys
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, HTML, display

PROJECT = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents]
               if (p / 'scripts/publication_programme/integrated_evidence.py').exists())
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT / 'scripts/publication_programme'))
import integrated_evidence as integration

# Report-level calculations and figures are recreated from saved aggregates.
# Raw-record analysis and independent R validation use the explicit refresh mode.
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
    evidence = integration.build()

def md(text): return Markdown('\n\n' + str(text) + '\n\n')
def raw(text): return HTML('\n\n' + str(text) + '\n\n')
def section(key):
    item = next(s for s in evidence['sections'] if s['id'] == key)
    for text in item['paragraphs']: display(md(text))
def table(key, collapsed=False):
    item = next(t for t in evidence['tables'] if t['id'] == key)
    frame = pd.DataFrame(item['rows'], columns=item['columns'])
    body = frame.to_html(index=False, escape=True)
    title = html.escape('Table ' + str(item['number']) + '. ' + item['title'])
    note = html.escape(item['note'])
    if collapsed:
        display(raw(f'<details class="provenance"><summary>{title}</summary>{body}<p>{note}</p></details>'))
    else:
        display(md('#### Table ' + str(item['number']) + '. ' + item['title']))
        display(raw(f'<div class="table-responsive">{body}</div><p>{note}</p>'))
def figure(key):
    item = next(f for f in evidence['figures'] if f['key'] == key)
    path = PROJECT / item['path']
    image = '../' + str(path.relative_to(PROJECT))
    display(md('#### Figure ' + item['id']))
    display(raw(f'<img class="paper-figure" src="{html.escape(image,quote=True)}" alt="{html.escape(item["alt"],quote=True)}">'))
    display(md(item['caption']))
    pdf = '../' + str(path.with_suffix('.pdf').relative_to(PROJECT))
    svg = '../' + str(path.with_suffix('.svg').relative_to(PROJECT))
    display(md(f'[Vector PDF]({pdf}) · [Editable SVG]({svg})'))

def extension(group):
    info=evidence['extensions'][group]
    for key in info['section_ids']:
        item=next(s for s in evidence['sections'] if s['id']==key)
        display(md('#### '+item['title']))
        section(key)
    for key in info['figure_keys']:figure(key)
    for key in info['table_ids']:table(key)

display(raw(f'<details class="provenance evidence-id" data-evidence-id="{evidence["content_sha256"]}"><summary>Reproducibility record</summary><p>Shared evidence identifier: <code>{evidence["content_sha256"]}</code></p></details>'))
```

### Reproducing the instrument analyses

The instrument figures, table cells and scientific Methods and Results text are
shared with the Word reports. This page verifies the saved evidence files and
recalculates the explicitly declared aggregate checks at render time. Source
record extraction and original analytical processing are separate operations;
they are not silently repeated when a reader renders this page. The aggregate
inputs and analysis code allow the instrument outputs to be reconstructed
without the external data volume. Original-source refresh additionally requires
the same authorised REM releases and annual coded templates.

The commands below are displayed for inspection and are not executed during
rendering. Use the scientific and document environments recorded by the runner.

```{python}
#| label: ni-instrument-explicit-rebuild-commands
#| eval: false
#| code-fold: true
import subprocess

# Rebuild the new instrument evidence and its matching Word and HTML reports
# from retained aggregate inputs.
subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/run_rem_instrument_extension.py', '--word', '--html'],
               cwd=PROJECT, check=True)

# Refresh source-record extraction only with the authorised data volume mounted.
subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/run_rem_instrument_extension.py', '--refresh-raw',
                '--word', '--html'], cwd=PROJECT, check=True)
```

## Reproducibility and original data sources

Survey data originate from [MDSF CASEN 2024](https://observatorio.ministeriodesarrollosocial.gob.cl/encuesta-casen-2024)
and [MINSAL ENCAVI 2023–2024](https://epi.minsal.cl/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Informe_metodologico_ENCAVI_2023_2024.pdf).
The ENCAVI documentation discrepancy is described in Methods.

Administrative data originate from [FONASA GRD](https://datosabiertos.fonasa.cl/dimensiones-financiamientos/),
[DEIS monthly statistical returns](https://deis.minsal.cl/#datosabiertos) and
[FONASA APS enrolment](https://public.tableau.com/views/ReporteInscritosCentrosAPS/ReporteAPS?:showVizHome=no).
The analysis uses the retained 2019–2024 GRD and 2019–2025 REM/enrolment snapshots.

Age denominators and contemporary context use [INE population projections](https://www.ine.gob.cl/estadisticas-por-tema/demografia-y-poblacion/estimaciones-y-proyecciones-de-poblacion)
and [MDSF municipal poverty estimates for 2024](https://observatorio.ministeriodesarrollosocial.gob.cl/pobreza-comunal-2024).
Administrative basemap boundaries originate from the [Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile Mapoteca](https://www.bcn.cl/siit/siit/mapas_vectoriales/).
The [original-source bibliography](reproductive_slides_references.bib) records the documents and catalogue links.

This report is one executable Quarto document. Its sections form a common
scientific narrative; they are not three separate reports. Rendering recalculates
report-level summaries from saved aggregate evidence and recreates the
integrated forest plots. The survey, surgical and care extensions are rebuilt
from their saved aggregate inputs by the runner below. The Word document uses the same Methods and Results prose,
table cells and PNG figure files. Original survey and GRD records remain outside the project. Public
facility coordinates are retained for the programme maps.

```{python}
#| label: inspectable-source-evidence
#| output: asis
sources = []
for folder in [integration.OUT, integration.MAN]:
    for path in sorted(folder.rglob('*.csv')):
        sources.append({'Evidence file': str(path.relative_to(PROJECT)),
                        'SHA256': integration.sha(path)})
display(raw('<details class="provenance"><summary>Inspect calculation files and checksums</summary>'
            + pd.DataFrame(sources).to_html(index=False,escape=True) + '</details>'))
```

Rebuild the connected evidence and this HTML from the saved aggregates:

```bash
python3 scripts/run_reproductive_life_course.py --word --html
```

Recalculate the primary analyses and base audits from the authorised source-derived
records, including the independent Python and R survey implementations, before rendering:

```bash
python3 scripts/run_reproductive_life_course.py --refresh-source-records --word --html
```

Render the presentation directly from its editable Quarto source:

```bash
quarto render docs/reproductive_key_results_slides.qmd --to revealjs
```

The presentation source contains its text, selected table cells and original figure paths.
The figures are the same files used in Word. Original institutional references are
recorded in the companion bibliography and linked on the slides. The PowerPoint
builder preserves editable text and tables and uses reversible crops of those figure files.

Verify the saved evidence and output hashes:

```bash
python3 scripts/run_reproductive_life_course.py --verify-only
```

The refresh mode requires the configured external inputs and R with the `survey`
package. `ASESORIAS_DATA_ROOT` and `MF_DERIVED` identify the authorised data
locations. Quarto uses the interpreter selected through `QUARTO_PYTHON`.
Word generation uses the configured document environment; `DOCX_PYTHON` can
override its bundled interpreter on another host.
The refresh command re-estimates the validated primary CASEN models and base
audits. Inherited exploratory estimates remain frozen source results; refreshing
the report does not repair their covariance or validate their exposure definitions.
Validated primary analyses, audited descriptive calculations, inherited
exploratory estimates and proposed analyses retain their separate status.
